payload.title: One cyclotron, many outputs: per-output rubrics, review, routing and monitoring
payload.description: Acceptance test from the marketing-site diagram work (Cyclotron-web). Use case: one cyclotron with several outputs (classifiers) answering a checklist of questions about one item. Each output has its own rubric, labels, ML model and evaluation, and all are optimized against reviewer labels; supporting questions feed each output's ML model as features. The core works today (embedded_cyclotron.py:70-119, 336-345; batched_classification.py:22-44). The child issues cover the gaps found when walking the use case end to end.
